run_mindis_kernel: run the mindis tensor comprehension kernel to compute minimum distance values and indices
run_reduce_codes_kernel: run the reduce_codes kernel to accumulate lookup table values indexed by uint8 codes
run_min_2d_kernel: run the min_2d kernel to find minimum values across a 2D tensor dimension
run_argmin_2d_kernel: run the argmin_2d kernel to find indices of minimum values in a 2D tensor
run_tc_define: run tc.define to compile tensor comprehension DSL strings into callable CUDA kernels
